thickness.note: Estimated from Zhang 2024: 50 wt% Pt on HSAC at 0.025 mg/cm² gives ~1 µm; scaling linearly to 0.1 mg/cm² ≈ 4 µm. CL thickness varies strongly with carbon support and Pt wt%.

catalyst_loading.note: Baseline cathode loading used for comparison against ultra-low (0.025) and SOA (0.5-1.0) mg_Pt/cm². Pt on high surface area carbon (HSAC), I/C = 0.35.

thickness.note: 50 wt% Pt on HSAC at 0.025 mg/cm² with I/C = 0.35; reported by Zhang 2024.

catalyst_loading.note: Ultra-low Pt loading — Zhang 2024 demonstrates comparable performance to baseline at 80 °C, 0.5 A/cm².
